pages.text: Sends an OPTIONS request: asks the server which methods an endpoint supports.$(br2)Many servers answer in the header $(1)allow$().

$(li)$(1)connection$() STRUCT c0de_net/http/HTTP_CONNECTION: the server$(li)$(1)endpoint$() STRING: the path behind the base endpoint (optional, default empty)$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the raw data of the answer$(li)result $(1)status$() INTEGER: the HTTP status
$(li)result $(1)headers$() HASH STRING: the headers of the answer
$(1)CALL c0de_net/http/HTTP_OPTIONS$(br)  PARAMETER connection api ;$(br)  PARAMETER endpoint "/lamps" ;$(br)  RESULT headers answerHeaders$()
